_doc: Upgrade cards (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 8), drawn by UpgradePool. power: true marks a card that raises an attack skill's damage output (a new attack skill, its rank, more shots/targets, damage, cooldown); pity.draws = N: after N draws in a row without a power card the next draw starts with one (0 = off). kind: skill_new (learn `skill`), skill_rank (+1 survivor rank of `skill`), skill_mod (modifies `skill`), passive / stat (player modifiers), potion_tier (changes potion_kind to item_id, preserves stock). requires (all optional): jobs (the player's job is one of these or a descendant), skills (owned skill keys), min_rank ({skill: rank}), min_level, potions ({kind: current item ID}). skill_rank and skill_mod cards also require owning `skill`; skill_new requires not owning it and a free slot of the skill's kind. max_rank 0 = unlimited. effects: {stat, op, value} applied once per rank taken; op add sums, op mul multiplies (compounds per rank), Potion tier cards have no stat effects. Skill stats: count, cooldown, pierce, speed, range, damage (multiplier), crit (chance, additive). Player stats: max_hp, max_mp, speed (speed stat points), magnet (radius), hp_regen and mp_regen (per s), pdd, damage, crit. desc: {value} is replaced by `value`. All numbers tier C (ours). Icons are WZ paths, all imported by the asset manifest: potion tiers use Item.wz/Consume 2000001/2000002/2000006 (items[]), Max HP the Warrior skill Improved MaxHP Increase 1000001 (Skill.wz/100.img) and Magnet the Meso Magnet pet equip 1812000 (Character.wz/PetEquip).
